name: Doximity
one_liner: Doximity is the largest professional medical network in the US, offering secure messaging, telehealth, e-fax, and clinical news for over 80% of US physicians.
best_for: Physicians and clinicians seeking a professional medical network
Providers needing HIPAA-compliant telehealth and messaging
Clinicians who want to stay updated on medical news and CME
Practices requiring secure e-fax and patient communication
not_for: Patients looking for direct healthcare services
Those seeking a standalone EHR system
short_description: Professional medical network with telehealth, secure messaging, e-fax, and clinical news for physicians.
long_description: Doximity is the largest professional medical network in the United States, connecting over 80% of US physicians. The platform provides a suite of clinical productivity tools including HIPAA-compliant video visits through Dialer, secure messaging between providers, electronic faxing, and curated medical news. For mental health professionals, Doximity offers a way to connect with referring physicians, conduct telehealth visits, and stay current with clinical developments. The platform also provides CME opportunities and career resources. Doximity is free for verified healthcare professionals and focuses on making clinical workflows more efficient.

pricing.notes: Free for verified healthcare professionals. Premium features available for enterprises.

privacy.notes: HIPAA-compliant platform designed for clinical communication.

faqs.q: What is Doximity and who can use it?
faqs.a: Doximity is a professional medical network for verified US healthcare professionals. It provides telehealth (Dialer), secure messaging, e-fax, and medical news. Over 80% of US physicians are on Doximity. It's free for verified providers.

Yes, Doximity's video visit feature (Dialer) is HIPAA-compliant and designed for clinical use. Patients don't need to download an app—they join via a link. Doximity offers Business Associate Agreements for covered entities.

faqs.q: How does Doximity compare to Zoom for Healthcare?
faqs.a: Both are HIPAA-compliant. Doximity Dialer is free for physicians and allows patients to join without an app. Zoom for Healthcare requires patient app download and typically has subscription costs. Doximity also includes messaging, e-fax, and professional networking.

faqs.q: Can mental health providers use Doximity?
faqs.a: Yes, psychiatrists, psychologists with prescribing privileges (where applicable), and other mental health physicians can use Doximity for telehealth, secure messaging with colleagues, e-fax for prescriptions and records, and staying current with CME.
